description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kahengama, Kuruwita D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620274
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, extent, location, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land registration, property ownership determinations, and cadastral mapping - all falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
